question.text: Coordination compound have great importance in biological systems. In this context which of the following statements is incorrect?

options.text: Chlorophylls are green pigments in plants and contains calcium
Carboxypeptidase $-\mathrm{A}$ is an enzyme and contains zinc
Haemoglobin is the red pigment of blood and contains iron

solution.text: Chlorophyll contains magnesium instead of calcium
